entities.name: Damir Imamović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Damir Imamović is a Bosnian singer-songwriter. His music is mostly in the traditional Bosnian genre of "sevdalinka" or "sevdah". His 2020 Album Singer of Tales won the 2021 Songlines Music Awards for Best European Album, and Imamović himself was nominated for Best Artist.
